payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over suffix: costs[i] = cost to fix sequence starting at i with step k, using recurrence costs[i] = costs[i+k] + (x if missing platform), then adds removal cost y*(i-p+1).
payload.rationale: Solution iterates from right to left storing prefix-independent costs, then adds removal penalty; it's a 1D DP, not 2D or recursion over tree/bitmask.
